scope: Eight paired development weeks; randomized menu-choice coverage, no promotion.
limitations: Eight whole-seed blocks, not independent requests.
Local contrasts concern the two menus under sequential exploratory eligibility; capacity and trust interfere across assignments.
Whole-week package includes suppressed scalar demand updates as well as relative-price exploration.
Unknown actions and outcomes are not no-purchase observations. No conditional-on-win comparison identifies substitution.
decision: Support permits separately frozen model assessment, not promotion or a causal claim for untested menus.
